full_judgment: 14. As regards non-examination of other neutral witnesses, P. W. I gave an explanation, that Majid, Abdur Rahman and Lal Miah are the members of the accused family and that witnesses liashem and Barek are brother-in-laws of the accused Abdul Kadir. P. W. 4 in his evidence gives another explanation that witnesses Shahed Ali and Makbul have been gained over by the accused and that Mokbul told him last night that he was afraid of the accused. The defence did not cross-examine them on those points. Therefore, we find that there are uncontroverted explanations on record as regards non-examination of some witnesses. The learned Additional Sessions Judge overlooked the explanation as regards non-examination of the charge-sheeted witnesses and erroneously drew an adverse presumption against the prosecution, which has no basis at all.
